name: motion-rack-focus
title: Rack Focus
description: Tiêu điểm chuyển từ lớp gần sang lớp xa: lớp này rõ dần thì lớp kia nhoè đi.

moworks.author: moworks

options.blur: px of the soft layer (8; 2.6 on the small frame)
options.toFar: false: focus comes to the near layers (default); true: it goes to the far ones
options.split: depth from which a layer is near (1)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Two depth layers: near blur 2.6 px -> 0 while far 0 -> 2.6 px over 650 ms easeInOutCubic (12-20 frames). Demo: near 4 -> 0 / far 0 -> 4 px over 0.6-1.4 s, back over 2.0-2.8 s. Params: duration (0.65 s) · blur (2.6 px) · ease (power2.inOut).
